author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I would take the argument in this essay one step further.  In the old days, the SASS companies tried to bundle up everything and sell you a platform.  

In the AI era, you only need to buy the piece that you can't and you don't want to build.  A platform is 90% simple boilerplate glue logics that AI can easily take care of if the documentation is good.

Build vs buy is dead — AI just killed it
